title: Exam day: rules and marking
html:
Sunday 4 October 2026 · Paper 1 GK 10:30–12:30 · Paper 2 Kannada/English/Computer 14:30–16:30.

Right+1
Wrong−0.25
5th circle ("not answered")0
Row left blank−0.25, same as wrong
  • Every row needs exactly one dark circle. After the last bell you get 5 extra minutes only to shade the 5th circle.
  • Shade the version code and booklet serial number carefully. A wrong version code means your sheet is checked against the wrong key.
  • Blue or black ballpoint only. Fully darken one circle; ticks, dots and half-fills count as wrong.
  • Be on campus 2 hours early (8:30 for Paper 1, 12:30 for Paper 2). No entry after the 3rd bell.
  • Bring the admit card and one original photo ID (Aadhaar is safest, since the ticket prints the Aadhaar photo).
  • Banned: any watch, phone, earphones, calculator, food, water (even sealed), bags, caps, eraser, ruler, pencil box, paper slips.
  • No watch inside, so pace yourself by the warning bells.

title: Negative marking: when to guess
html:
Break-even: a guess pays if your chance of being right is above 20% (p − 0.25(1 − p) > 0).

SituationAverage marks per guess
Blind guess, 4 options+0.06
One option ruled out+0.17
Two options ruled out+0.38
Blank row−0.25 (never do this)
  • Rule out what you can, then guess. Use the 5th circle only when an option looks like a deliberate trap pulling you in.
  • "Which is NOT / incorrect" and "how many pairs are correct" questions are the traps. Read the stem twice.
  • Options are sometimes printed out of order. Shade by the number, never by position.
  • First pass: answer everything you know (about 60 seconds each). Second pass: the eliminations. Last 5 minutes: fill every row.

KEA's official VAO 2024 score list for Bengaluru Urban (1,276 qualified), out of 200: #1 145 · #2 144.75 · #3 138.5 · #4 138 · #5 135 · #10 130 · #20 125 · #50 113.75 · #100 107.

What it means for a 3A man who did not study 1st–10th in a rural school: the only 3A post is reserved for a woman, so you compete for the general-merit posts open to men: the 1 "Others" post, plus any ex-servicemen, project-displaced or transgender posts that go unfilled (these usually pass to general candidates, but that is not guaranteed). That means a top-3 rank in the district.

Target: 145 out of 200. Below about 135 is very unlikely to be enough. The best Paper 2 score in 2024 was 76.5, so Paper 2 is where you beat the field: English 33, Computer 27, Kannada 20 = 80. Paper 1: 65.

title: Block 1: Panchayat Raj and land revenue
html:
Constitution, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)

  • In force 24 April 1993 (National Panchayati Raj Day). Articles 243 to 243-O. 11th Schedule = 29 subjects.
  • Root: Article 40 (Directive Principle): organise village panchayats.
  • 74th Amendment: municipalities, Part IXA, 243P–243ZG, 12th Schedule = 18 subjects, in force 1 June 1993.
ArticleWhat it covers
243AGram Sabha
243BThree tiers; middle tier optional if state population ≤ 20 lakh
243DReservation: SC/ST by population; women at least 1/3, including chairpersons
243ETerm 5 years; if dissolved, election within 6 months
243FDisqualification; minimum age 21
243GPowers and duties (11th Schedule)
243IState Finance Commission, every 5 years, set up by the Governor
243KState Election Commission (appointed by the Governor, removed only like a High Court judge)

Committees (B-A-G-L)

  • Balwantrai Mehta 1957: three tiers; first launched at Nagaur, Rajasthan, 2 Oct 1959.
  • Ashok Mehta 1977: two tiers.
  • G.V.K. Rao 1985: district as the planning unit.
  • L.M. Singhvi 1986: constitutional status for panchayats.

Karnataka

  • 1983 Act: Mandal Panchayats (elections 1987). CM Ramakrishna Hegde, minister Abdul Nazir Sab.
  • Karnataka Panchayat Raj Act 1993, renamed the Karnataka Gram Swaraj and Panchayat Raj Act in 2015.
  • Officers: Gram Panchayat → PDO; Taluk Panchayat → Executive Officer; Zilla Panchayat → CEO (IAS).
  • Karnataka reserves 50% of panchayat seats for women (constitutional minimum is 1/3).
  • ANSSIRD&PR → Mysuru; NIRDPR → Hyderabad.

Land revenue

  • Permanent Settlement (Zamindari): Cornwallis, 1793, Bengal-Bihar-Odisha; zamindar = middleman.
  • Ryotwari: Thomas Munro, 1820, Madras and Bombay; settled directly with the ryot (farmer).
  • Mahalwari: Holt Mackenzie, 1822, North-West Provinces and Punjab; the village (mahal) is the unit.
  • Karnataka Land Revenue Act 1964; Land Reforms Act 1961 (in force 1965); 1974 amendment (Devaraj Urs) = "land to the tiller".
  • RTC / Pahani = Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops. Bhoomi = Karnataka's computerised land records.

Traps

  • 11th Schedule (panchayats, 29) vs 12th (municipalities, 18).
  • "Women at least 1/2 under the Constitution" is false: it is 1/3. The 50% is Karnataka law.
  • Gram Sabha is 243A, not 243B or 243G.
  • Ryot = one farmer; Mahal = a village; Zamindar = a middleman.

title: How to use this app
html:
• Study works like Anki: new cards, then reviews at the right time. Tap an option; if you were right, rate Hard / Good / Easy. Wrong answers come back in a minute.
  • Practice gives quick quizzes with exam marking (+1 / −0.25 / 0 for skip) from any section, paper or deck.
  • Mock runs a full official paper with a 2-hour timer and an OMR-style answer grid, then marks it the KEA way.
  • Mistakes collects everything you got wrong or skipped. A card leaves the list after two correct answers in a row.
  • Tap any question picture to zoom. Keys 1–5 and Enter work on a laptop.
  • Install: in Chrome, tap ⋮ → Add to Home screen (or the Install button on Home). Then Settings → Download all images on Wi-Fi to use it offline.
  • Your progress lives on this phone only. Use Settings → Export progress now and then as a backup.
